# Schools & courses

Training schools, summer schools and short courses on thermal radiation,
radiative properties and emissivity measurement. Conferences and workshops
are in the [conference calendar](/events-news/conferences.html). All entries
are also in the [iCal feed](/files/ical/emissivity-conferences.ics).

This listing began in 2026 with the TAMARYS school in Hendaye. It will grow into
a record of training in the field, just as the conference calendar records its
meetings. To add a school or course, use the
[contribution form](/contribute/index.html).
:::
